description: Free. Validate a Solana token launch before building it: normalises name/symbol/supply/decimals, applies a typed allow/review/deny gate, states the authority policy (mint revoked, no freeze authority by default) and returns the exact on-chain cost in SOL and USD. Use this first — it costs nothing and catches the mistakes that would otherwise be signed.

freeze_authority.description: default none — we never set a freeze authority unless asked

revoke_mint_authority.description: default true — fixed supply, the trust signal buyers screen for

supply.description: Total supply in UI units as an exact integer string, e.g. "1000000000"

symbol.description: Token symbol, 1-10 characters, uppercase letters and digits

uri.description: https:// or ipfs:// URL of the off-chain metadata JSON (logo and description)

name: sol_launch_plan
title: Plan a Solana token launch (free)
